sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
        c.TERM_CODE,
        c.SUBJECT_ID,
        c.TOTAL_UNITS,
        c.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s
      ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
     AND s.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
    WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
      AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 6
      AND s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        f.*,
        MAX(f.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (
            PARTITION BY f.ACADEMIC_YEAR
        ) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS
    FROM filtered f
)
SELECT
    r.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    r.TOTAL_UNITS AS HIGHEST_TOTAL_UNITS,
    t.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    r.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (
        PARTITION BY r.ACADEMIC_YEAR
    ) AS NUMBER_OF_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
    MIN(r.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (
        PARTITION BY r.ACADEMIC_YEAR
    ) AS MIN_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM ranked r
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = r.TERM_CODE
WHERE r.TOTAL_UNITS = r.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS
ORDER BY r.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

sql_reading_B.sql:
WITH current_year AS (
    SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR
    FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL
    WHERE IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        c.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
        c.TERM_CODE,
        c.SUBJECT_ID,
        c.TOTAL_UNITS,
        c.DEPARTMENT_NAME
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
    JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY s
      ON s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
     AND s.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE
    JOIN current_year cy
      ON cy.ACADEMIC_YEAR = c.ACADEMIC_YEAR
    WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
      AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 6
      AND s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10
)
SELECT
    f.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    MAX(f.TOTAL_UNITS) AS HIGHEST_TOTAL_UNITS,
    MIN(t.TERM_DESCRIPTION) KEEP (
        DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY f.TOTAL_UNITS DESC
    ) AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    MIN(f.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUMBER_OF_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
    MIN(f.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MIN_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM filtered f
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t
  ON t.TERM_CODE = f.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY f.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY f.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question_text: For each academic year, what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, the term description for the corresponding term, the department name, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units offered, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units, and only departments and academic years where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics? List the academic year, highest total units, term description, department name, number of unique subjects, and minimum total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
